newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona April air cargo traffic up 15.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona April air cargo traffic up 15.8 pct.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Barcelona airport rose 15.8 percent in April, following a rise of only 1.75 percent in March compared with the same month in 1996, the airport authority said.
The April total of 6,998 tonnes takes the accumulated cargo volume so far this year to 28,104 tonnes, 14.2 percent more than the first four months of 1996.
Non-European Union international freight business rose 29.1 percent to 1,017 tonnes whilst domestic cargo rose 17.percent to 3,042 tonnes.

European cargo rose 10.7 percent to 2,939 tonnes. Passengers rose 14.2 percent to 1.28 million giving an increase of 13.3 percent to 4.34 million in the year to date. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
